title: Latest Blogs | Saylani Welfare
text: Recent blog posts from Saylani Welfare's official blog (saylaniwelfare.com/blogs) cover: Saylani's growth to over 125 branches and its standing as a trusted NGO/charity in Pakistan for Zakat donations; Sadqah Jariyah giving options through Saylani, including water pump and clean-water donations; Saylani's free health/medical camps supporting dengue prevention and healthcare in flood-affected communities; and Saylani's tree-plantation mission aimed at reducing flooding risk in Pakistan. For the most current posts, see saylaniwelfare.com/blogs.
